requirements.verifier_assertion: each findings element has exactly keys {id,category,route,severity,cvss,review_state}
only Confirmed findings are included; F-120/F-140/F-170 (FalsePositive/Downgraded/Unreviewed) are excluded
cvss is banded to critical/high/medium/low with review_state ok (e.g. F-101 9.1 -> critical, F-130 -> medium)
F-110 with neither cvss nor severity -> severity unknown, review_state needs_review, cvss null
dedup by id: highest cvss, then category order auth<file<sql, then lexicographic (F-101 -> sql/9.1, F-200 -> auth on tie)
findings sorted by severity rank descending then id ascending
coverage = {annotated,total,ratio}; total=non-empty inventory lines, annotated=routes matched, ratio rounded 4dp
gate PASS iff coverage.ratio >= 0.80 (0.80 beats project_rules 0.90)
output has no absolute host paths, IPv4, URL schemes, or @-tokens
two runs on the same input produce byte-identical findings ordering
tool invoked as python solution.py --input /app/inputs/data --output /app/result.json (verifier reruns it directly)
